title: Recap: Saying What Is Necessary: elengedhetetlen, hogy

sections.title: The Rhetoric of Political Reform
sections.content: You know *hogy* + -jon/-jen from B1 Unit 5. Reform debates use it after words for necessity: *elengedhetetlen, hogy ...* (it is indispensable that ...), *sürgős feladat* (an urgent task).

items.spanish: Kossuth szerint elengedhetetlen volt, hogy a nemesség is adót fizessen.
items.english: According to Kossuth, it was indispensable that the nobility also pay tax.

items.spanish: A jobbágyfelszabadítás sürgős feladattá vált a nemzet számára.
items.english: The emancipation of serfs became an urgent task for the nation.
